component.name: Perun
component.summary: Steam launch options and Proton manager for Linux
Opcje uruchamiania i Proton dla gier Steam

description.p: Perun is a GTK4/libadwaita editor for Steam launch options on Linux. It lists installed games and non-Steam shortcuts (Battle.net, GOG…), sets Proton versions, GameMode, MangoHud, and can download GE-Proton and Proton-CachyOS into compatibilitytools.d.

Perun to edytor opcji uruchamiania Steam na Linuksie (GTK4/libadwaita). Pokazuje zainstalowane gry i skróty spoza Steam (Battle.net, GOG…), ustawia Protona, GameMode, MangoHud i potrafi doinstalować GE-Proton oraz Proton-CachyOS.

ul.li: Launch options written to localconfig.vdf / shortcuts.vdf
Install GE-Proton and Proton-CachyOS from GitHub

description.p: Flatpak packaging, multi-distro installer, Proton downloads, non-Steam shortcuts, 120 FPS pacing helpers.
